_note: Module 158/164 supervisor-layer hazards — questions that must NOT select Meta-Analysis (a decomposition is 5-8 sub-queries and ~130 s on this model server). WRITTEN BEFORE ANY SCORE WAS SEEN. These are in ADDITION to the 29 non-Meta-Analysis gold questions, Module 145's 24 hazards and 6 targets, Module 92's 87 non-Meta-Analysis paraphrases, Module 144's 13 filtered counts and prompts/router.txt's exemplars, all of which the probe loads as hazards too. Each is chosen to sit NEAR one plan's description on topic while being a one-call (or one-route) question.
